title: Synthetic Demo Scorecard
description: Defines the structure and public/restricted field policy for scorecard records produced by this benchmark.

benchmark_id.description: Identifies the benchmark this scorecard belongs to. Must be 'omaib-synthetic-demo'.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation run (e.g. 'run-2026-04-01-001').

model_id.description: Identifier of the model being evaluated (e.g. 'clinicalbert-finetuned-v2').

macro_f1.description: Macro-averaged F1 score across all seven routing categories. Public field.

routing_accuracy.description: Top-1 routing label accuracy across the test split. Public field.

per_class_recall.description: Per-category recall scores. Restricted field — requires Data Governance Lead approval to release.

overall_metrics_summary.description: Free-text summary of overall performance for the public leaderboard entry.
